# Blue Oak Cost Control 1.0.0
The first production release of Blue Oak Cost Control.
- Guided, skippable startup tour covering the complete workflow. - Project setup with configurable VAT, labour rates, historic project/person rates, and generated project codes. - Professional Greek proposal builder with photographs and PDF export. - Accepted-proposal locking, linked change orders, and approved variations. - Payment milestones, deposits, retention, and receipts tracking. - Contract value, committed costs, forecast final cost, and expected gross-margin reporting. - Invoice and receipt photographs attached directly to cost records. - Encrypted local snapshots after changes and on close, plus portable exports. - Built-in signed update checking for future releases.
